metaDescription: Free online BMR Calculator. Calculate your Basal Metabolic Rate.
intro: Use our free online BMR Calculator tool. It estimates basal metabolic rate based on your inputs.
whatIs: The BMR Calculator is an online utility that estimates basal metabolic rate. It processes your age, height, weight and provides calories burned resting completely.
howToUse: Enter your age, height, weight into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like gender.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate calories burned resting completely.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your age, height, weight. It instantly processes the data to output calories burned resting completely.
workedExample: For example: A 30yr old male might have a BMR of ~1800 kcal.
resultInterpretation: The result represents calories burned resting completely. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing age, height, weight on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Formulas like Mifflin-St Jeor provide an estimate, not a lab result.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Does BMR include exercise?
faq.answer: No, BMR is strictly the energy needed to stay alive at rest.

faq.question: Is the BMR Calculator free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our BMR Calculator is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
